image: So the noble one is together,
lines: A horse lost: do not chase it —
Meeting your lord in a lane.
the man branded, his nose cut off.
No beginning — there is an end.
Your kin bite through the skin.
Estranged, alone: a pig carrying dirt, a cartload of ghosts.
First the bow is drawn on them, then the bow is laid down.

notes.name_en: 睽 is eyes turned apart, estrangement; 'Estranged', not Wilhelm's 'Opposition'.
notes.L3: 天且劓: 天 read as forehead-branding (黥), 劓 nose-cutting — a punished man, kept concrete.
notes.L6: The suitors refrain (3 L2) kept in the same words; ghosts were the marriage party mis-seen.
